issue_title: [Feature] Add file-based backup/snapshot before destructive operations

implementation.summary: Add backup/snapshot functionality to TodoStorage for safe destructive operations

changes.description: Added backup_before_save and max_backups parameters to save(), _create_backup(), _backup_path(), and load_backup() methods
New test file with 11 tests covering backup creation, rotation, and restore functionality

features.backup_creation: Creates .bak.N files before overwriting when backup_before_save=True
features.rotation: Keeps max_backups files (default 3), numbered 0 (newest) to N-1 (oldest)
features.restore: load_backup(n) method to restore from any backup index
features.opt_in: Backups disabled by default, must explicitly enable with backup_before_save=True

risks: Backup files stored in same directory as main file - may need cleanup
No automatic backup restore - user must call load_backup() manually
commands_executed: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_backup_restore.py
